allow: PowerShell(Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source; Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Source; $env:PATH -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ -match 'node|npm' })
